Mod.Name: FF8 Steam Deck Button Glyphs
Mod.Author: todi
Mod.Description:
Shows the Steam Deck / Steam Controller buttons (A, B, X, Y, L1/R1, L2/R2, View, Menu) wherever FF8 names a button, instead of "B1", "B2", ... The glyphs follow your bindings from the in-game Config screen.
Works with the Steam 2013 and Remastered editions, in every game language. Junction VIII turns on FFNx's ff8_use_gamepad_icons for you while the mod is active. With AxlRose's WIP (UI on): place this mod above it in the list.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: 1.10: works in every game language, including Japanese, and with the low-res icons; smaller download. 1.00: new preview image. 0.9: button glyphs are smaller and sharp-edged, so they no longer overlap the next line of text. Auto Sort now places this mod above AxlRose's WIP. 0.8: first catalog release, textures only.
